THE PRODUCT

AI reviews building inspection images and notes, then drafts an evidence-linked repair list.

For facility managers and building maintenance teams. Brickwise groups repeated defects in photos, reads technician notes and suggests which issues need a qualified inspection first.

THE PRODUCT, IN USE

A survey becomes
a repair plan.

Choose a case, run the prepared analysis and open the evidence behind each finding. The decision stays with the person responsible for the work.

WHAT THE TEAM RECEIVES

A report you can
actually review.

The report groups the visible issue and the technician’s note under one asset. The facility manager approves the actual work.

01

The source

Open the relevant extract and see which file or observation supports the finding.

02

A specific finding

Read what changed, what conflicts or what evidence is still missing.

03

An operator action

A facility manager confirms the finding and assigns a qualified contractor.

04

A retained decision

Accept the prepared finding for review, add a note in the register and download the report.

HOW THE JOB GETS DONE

Four steps.
One useful decision.

An image cannot certify structural or equipment safety. A qualified professional inspects the condition and approves the work.

  1. 01

    Read the inspection

    Group the images and notes by building and asset.

  2. 02

    Find repeated defects

    Look for visible changes, damage and repeated reports of the same issue.

  3. 03

    Draft the repair list

    Attach the source and explain why the issue needs attention.

  4. 04

    Approve the work

    A facility manager confirms the finding and assigns a qualified contractor.
